exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) with a macrosomic neonate (birth weight > 4000 g)
trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) with a macrosomic neonate
Neonatal birth weight (3500-4000 g vs. >4000 g)
cohort: Women attempting TOLAC with a singleton pregnancy
finding: Women attempting TOLAC with a macrosomic neonate are not at increased risk for failed TOLAC, operative vaginal delivery, uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, or obstetric anal sphincter injury but are at risk of shoulder dystocia.
